TEXT: The vast sky. The white sandy beach. The blue sea.

On a certain day during the few remaining days of 
summer vacation, we came down to the beach.

Stepping onto the sand that's like a heated frying 
pan, it made me worry whether my own beach 
sandals would melt.

In the midst of the uninterrupted sunlight shining 
down...
I waited for my girlfriend... or not.
I waited for my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: She's so slow... What is she doing?
I've been waiting for more than long enough.

My, my... I probably have too much free time, since 
I'm thinking of unnecessary things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't a swimsuit just pieces of cloth?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why did you take so long to put it on?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you saying? I don't get what you mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: That's why I told you not to wear a bikini.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: But you said that it would definitely be fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, you're right. You're a kid, yet you're wearing 
such an adult swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: D-Don't stare at me so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why did you wear it if it's so embarrassing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Crying then smiling, you're such a hectic girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Now I've been told that she isn't my younger sister.

Kirino and I only learned about this just recently. 
So...

At the very least, I haven't come to terms with it 
yet.

Even though I normally interacted with her as if it 
were nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uwah! W-What the... when did you get here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh? Isn't it because you were spacing out?

The fact that I didn't ask "How's what?" here 
might be because I was "thinking while spaced 
out".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It really is better to see it in person than in a 
magazine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You're making it sound perverted, you know.
As if I'd feel that way towards my younger sister--
Wait, but she's no longer my younger sister.
This is bad, I'm suddenly conscious of her.
Kirino narrowed her eyes at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Your expression is also perverted. What are you 
thinking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
About the past. Back when you were a little brat, 
we came here with our entire family.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
When I recalled what you said that day, I felt really 
irritated, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That happened a long time ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Besides, a big brother's attitude is like that towards 
his younger sister.
Yes, if it's towards a younger sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Back then, we still got along well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Now, we've reached the point where we can come 
to the beach together, just like old times.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Did we change from back then?
There's no way we didn't change.
We may be about to start changing a lot more.
